verdicts.why: Nothing passes between Jessica and Stick in The Defenders#6: Elektra has already beaten Stick when Matt and Jessica charge in, and she kills him while Matt pleads; Jessica only witnesses it. Same room with nothing between them is not a stage.
In Daredevil S1#2 Josie serves Karen and Foggy, tells them they cannot drink for free and tells Karen she could do better; Karen stays a regular through S1 and S2, so the connection starts there.

In The Punisher S2#13 Pilgrim admits the Schultzes hold his sons, asks Castle to spare them, goes with Castle and Amy to the Schultz mansion and takes his sons back while Castle leaves Anderson to kill himself. A clear turn on his bosses with no stage.
Same S2#13 events: Pilgrim turns on the Schultzes and rescues his sons from their mansion while Castle shoots Eliza. The boss tie ends there with no stage.

Karen sends the Red Hook Charter to McCaffrey anonymously in Born Again S2#3, so McCaffrey never knows her; in S2#8 they are only stuck in the same locked-down courthouse with nothing recorded between them. Knowing about someone is not a connection.
In Jessica Jones S3#13 Jessica's fight is with Trish, who grabs Kith as a hostage; Jessica and Kith exchange nothing, and they share no other scene in S3 (it is Jeri who visits Kith in S3#1).

Born Again S1#1 has Karen move to San Francisco after Foggy's death; in S1#9 she has Castle protect Matt after Dex escapes, reunites with him, and they find Foggy's files showing Red Hook is a free port. The reunion has no stage.

In Daredevil S3#6 Ellison, who ordered Karen off Fisk in S3#3, tells her 'I owe you an apology... Lead on' and joins her interview with Jasper Evans at the Bulletin. A clear reconciliation before the S3#7 firing.

In Daredevil S3#12 Ellison, who fired Karen in S3#7, hugs her when she finds him ('Welcome back'), agrees to call the press conference and stands with her as she announces Nadeem's testimony. A reconciliation with no stage.

value.title: Daredevil S3#3
value.text: Karen Page confronts FBI agent Ray Nadeem over Fisk's move to a hotel, and he tells her to write about the agents who died guarding Fisk instead.
value.on_a_card_about_b: An FBI agent on Fisk's detail who brushes off Karen's questions.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A reporter who presses Nadeem over Fisk's deal.

verdicts.why: The connection does start before S3#11, but earlier than S3#5: in S3#3 Karen confronts Nadeem outside Fisk's hotel prison and he tells her to write about the agents who died moving Fisk. S3#5's questioning and S3#6's meeting follow from there.
Dex kills Nadeem at the end of S3#12, and in S3#13 Karen puts Nadeem's recorded dying declaration on social media, exposing Fisk. His death and the use of his testimony have no stage.

In Daredevil S2#3, after the failed sting, Karen and Foggy confront Reyes; she shows no sympathy, tells Karen the firm is out of its league and threatens to blame them. A real exchange well before S2#10.

In S2#10 Reyes herself confirms to Matt, Foggy and Karen that her sting led to the Castle family's deaths, pleads for help, and is shot dead in front of them. The current text has Karen uncovering it and leaves out the death.
In Born Again S2#4 Matt is in hiding and Karen will not say where; it is Karen who gets McDuffie to record Christofi Savva's testimony. McDuffie does not work with Matt in that title.

In S2#7 Matt comes out of hiding to defend Karen alongside McDuffie, and the AVTF attacks them both. That is the two law partners and friends doing their job together, not a turn: nothing changes between them.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#13
value.text: When Hunter and Bobbi are held after the Russia mission, Coulson offers to break them out, but they choose to be disavowed to protect S.H.I.E.L.D., and he sends them off with a spy's goodbye.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The director who lets Hunter go when he is disavowed to protect S.H.I.E.L.D.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A loyal agent who chooses to be disavowed to protect S.H.I.E.L.D.

verdicts.why: The event checks out (AoS S3#13: Coulson offers an EMP escape, Hunter and Bobbi choose to be disavowed, and the team gives them a spy's goodbye). But from this title on Coulson is no longer Hunter's boss, since Hunter has left S.H.I.E.L.D. for good, so the kind is friend.
The poisoning happens at Fisk's gala in Daredevil S1#10: Owlsley and Gao plan it, Owlsley hands Vanessa the poisoned champagne, and she collapses. S1#12 only has them talking it over afterwards.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#13
value.text: Fitz and Jemma trust Piper to guard the module that hides their daughter, and in return they bring her friend Davis back as a Life-Model Decoy.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who guards the module hiding Fitz's daughter.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who trusts Piper with his daughter and rebuilds Davis for her as a Life-Model Decoy.

verdicts.why: The event is right (AoS S7#13: Fitz and Simmons have Piper guard the module that turns out to hold Alya, and in return they bring Davis back). But the Davis they bring back is a Life-Model Decoy, so the text and card line must say so.

value.title: Luke Cage S2#7
value.text: Luke pulls Mariah and her daughter out of the burning house where Bushmaster leaves them to die.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Luke's rival for Harlem, whom he saves from a fire and protects from Bushmaster.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Mariah's rival for Harlem, who saves her from a fire and protects her.

verdicts.why: Luke does carry Mariah and Tilda out of Bushmaster's fire in Luke Cage S2#7, a clear turn to reluctant allies. But the promise to protect her is not in S2#7: in S2#8 he tells her he does not work for her and only promised to get her to safety. The text keeps only the S2#7 event.

value.title: Luke Cage S2#12
value.text: Luke tells Mariah he will not save her again, but he still fights off Bushmaster at her club, and he and Misty watch as she is arrested.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Luke's rival for Harlem, whose arrest he watches after one last rescue.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Mariah's rival for Harlem, who swears off protecting her, then watches her arrest.

verdicts.why: In Luke Cage S2#12 Luke tells Mariah he will not save her a third time and she is arrested while he and Misty watch, which ends the truce. But that same night he still fights Bushmaster off her at the club, so 'stops protecting her' is not true as written.
In Luke Cage S2#13 Misty meets Luke at Harlem's Paradise, calls him a dictator and warns she will arrest him if he does wrong. Allies turn to wary rivals with no stage.

In Born Again S2#8 Luke tells Jessica, on screen, that the CIA let him go home because Mr. Charles found someone else (Dex); Mr. Charles recruits Dex and releases Luke. The end of the tie is stated on screen and has no stage.
In Luke Cage S1#6 Scarfe dies of his wounds while Luke and Claire are taking him to 1 Police Plaza. A death is a stage, and this one is missing from the text.

In Luke Cage S1#10 Luke and Claire go through Burstein's files and learn that Reva knew about Rackham's fights and was feeding the program candidates, with Lucas as its most promising subject. A clear betrayal revealed after the S1#4 stage.

In AoS S3#11 Elena knocks Mack out and ties him up; he later frees her, shows her that her cousin was murdered, she helps rescue Bobbi and Hunter, and Mack gives her a watch to call them. They meet and work together well before S4#8.

At the end of AoS S4#22 Enoch and his men freeze Coulson's team, Mack included, and take them away; in S5#1 he sends them to 2091. This is where their connection starts, and the card lines avoid the later Chronicom reveal.

In AoS S7#6 and S7#7 Mack and Deke are stranded in 1982; Deke checks on the grieving Mack for a year, brings him to his new squad, and they defeat Sibyl's hunters together. A clear new chapter in their friendship with no stage.
The Coulson in S7 is a Life Model Decoy. Under the ruling, a version played by an LMD is not the person, so there is no stage for it while the real Coulson is not there.
Gao decides to join Owlsley in poisoning Vanessa in Daredevil S1#10, and Vanessa is poisoned at the gala in that episode; S1#12 only has them talking about it afterwards.

Gao plots Vanessa's poisoning behind Fisk's back (S1#10) and leaves the city (S1#12); in S1#13 Fisk learns that Owlsley and Gao conspired to poison Vanessa. Their alliance ends in betrayal with no stage.

In Daredevil S3#7 Melvin admits Fisk forced him to copy the suit, locks Matt in a cage with a second copy to frame him, and the two fight off the FBI before Matt escapes and Melvin is taken into custody.

In Born Again S2#8 Matt calls Fisk as a witness, reveals he is Daredevil, then fights through the lockdown and talks Fisk into taking the exile deal; Fisk leaves New York. A major turn after the S1 stage.
In Born Again S2#8 McCaffrey and her attorney general offer Fisk exile in place of charges during the courthouse lockdown; he takes the deal and leaves New York.

In Luke Cage S2#9 Tilda confronts Mariah, who admits killing Cottonmouth and reveals Tilda was conceived through Uncle Pete's rape, which is why she does not love her. This ends the reunion, and it has no stage.
In Born Again S1#7 Daredevil rescues Heather from Muse and fights him, and Heather shoots Muse dead. His death is a stage and is missing.

In Daredevil S2#9 Nobu, back from the dead, beats Daredevil at the Farm and escapes with the sarcophagus. The Hand's claim on Elektra as the Black Sky only comes out in S2#12, so the current text gives away a later title.
In Daredevil S2#13 Nobu goes to stab Daredevil with Elektra's sai, Elektra steps in front and dies, and Daredevil throws Nobu off the roof. Elektra's death and Nobu's end have no stage.

value.title: Daredevil S2#10
value.text: Reyes asks Matt and Foggy for help finding Castle and admits her part in the park massacre, then is shot dead in front of them.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The DA who turns to Matt for help, and is shot dead in front of him.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A lawyer she turns to for help just before she is shot dead.

verdicts.why: The event is right (Daredevil S2#10: Reyes confesses her sting caused the massacre, pleads for help and is shot dead in front of Matt, Foggy and Karen). But one plea for help in her last moments does not make them allies, so the kind stays enemy, matching the same S2#10 stage on the Karen-Reyes connection.
